title: reveiw
goal:
инит и навигатор настроены. Теперь давай настроим review.
Для начала только локальный ревью. ревью из PR в конце, тк оно по сути повторяет локальный. 

создай новые eval кейсы основанные на фикстурах мы использовали для init. не более 12 в сумме. Старые кейсы сотри.

Далее сам тюнинг, сравнение с bare baseline
Ревью должно спотать все кейсы, которые не проходят 
- по политикам, описанные в rules и собранные по проекту
- Отличаются по code-style и архитектуре проекта
- Переизбыток кода либо раздутая  или переусложненная реализация в местах где есть более простое или элегантное решение
- Плохоай нейминг, code smells, лишние комментарии, мертвый код, дублирующийся код

можешь еще накидать дополнительно, чему должен следовать качественный ревьюер

phases.title: Case design: inventory the local review path (skills/review, routes/review, prompts/ reviewer contract, policies) and the old review eval cases; write a matrix of the minimal necessary number of cases (12-20) over the init fixtures (ts/python/go/jvm/monorepo) with planted defects per category: policy from rules.md and collected project rules, code-style/architecture deviation, bloat/over-engineering with a simpler existing solution, naming/smells/redundant comments/dead code/duplication, plus extras (correctness bug, missing test for new behaviour, swallowed error/security) and 1-2 clean-diff controls for false positives. Done when the user approves the matrix; decisions in DECISIONS.md.

Case generator: evals/scripts/review-cases.mjs builds the approved cases from fixtures/init-stacks.mjs (fixture + diff + truth of expected findings with file/line/category), deterministic graders (per planted defect: finding names file and issue; control: no blocking finding; route/tool_used on the steps), old review cases deleted along with what only supported them. Done when generation is reproducible, a generator test passes and npm run verify is green.

Baseline: bare (sonnet) and current plugin local review on all cases (runs and cost confirmed with the user first); per case and per category record defect recall, false positives, severity correctness, cost, turns, duration in STATE.md. Done when both arms are recorded and the failing categories are named with trace evidence.

Local review tuning, agents/reviewer.md first (main mechanism): first hypothesis lets observed project conventions count as violations; loosen rules if controls/off-target findings get noisy; then the weakest category (how rules/context/conventions reach the reviewer, diff scoping, finding format). One hypothesis per iteration on a 3-4 case subset, confirm on all cases. Done when the plugin beats bare on recall with no more false positives at comparable or lower cost, confirmed on the full set and committed.

PR review: verify the PR route reuses the tuned local review path (only fetch/diff/comment posting differ); add at most 1-2 PR cases inside the 20 budget or reuse fixtures; done when they pass at the local-review level.
Release: remove dead code from the old review path, npm run verify green, version bump, STATE.md and DECISIONS.md updated, commit.
